svg.title: SPOD-DR framework and joint optimization
svg.desc: SPOD-DR architecture and joint optimization. Feature maps, attention maps, severity distributions, and probability bars are schematic rather than measured model outputs. Thin solid paths show forward computation; dashed paths show training dependencies; thick solid arrows show parameter steps. Historical audit metadata are preserved in Fig1_C2_SAM_historical_audit.json.
